$description: Portfolio design tokens, DTCG source of truth. Generated artifact is tokens.css (symlinked into the portfolio + case studies). Two-tier: primitives (hue+stop) feed semantics (role). Faithful v1 transcription of the hand-written tokens.css; naming aliases + $type annotations layered in a later stage.

0.$description: Card surface; text on an accent fill.

150.$description: Half-step. accent-subtle on light; text-primary on dark.

700.$description: Text-secondary on light; strong border on dark.

850.$description: Half-step. Brand ink; accent on light; surface on dark.

950.$description: bg on dark; text-primary on light; accent-hover on light.

400.$description: Lime tint, one step under the brand value.

500.$description: Brand lime. The single canonical lime, the only stop consumed as identity (--brand-lime).

550.$description: Hover-dim lime, between 500 and 600; the target of --brand-lime-dim.

600.$description: Saturated lime shade. Higher OKLCH chroma (0.229) than green-500 (0.2134), the deliberate hand-tuned saturation peak.

900.$description: Darkest usable lime, a near-black green.

lime-rgb.$description: Channel form of --brand-lime for decorative alpha shadows: rgb(var(--brand-lime-rgb) / 0.2). DERIVED by build.mjs from the referenced colour's hex anchor (audit TK-05), never hand-typed.

ink-rgb.$description: Channel form of --brand-ink for ink-at-alpha: rgb(var(--brand-ink-rgb) / 0.65). DERIVED by build.mjs from the referenced colour's hex anchor (audit TK-05).

gradient.$description: CSS-only composite; reads var(--brand-lime) and var(--brand-emphasis-2) so the gradient follows a brand re-point at CSS level (audit TK-05; DTCG forbids embedded aliases inside string values, review 2026-06-10).

anthropic-large.$description: Anthropic orange, 18px+ bold. EXTERNAL brand: a locked, theme-agnostic constant, never aliased into a semantic token, not part of our palette.

anthropic-body.$description: Anthropic orange, darker 12-14px variant for contrast. External brand: locked constant.

linkedin.$description: LinkedIn brand blue, the LinkedIn mark only. External brand: locked constant.

bupa-blue.$description: Bupa brand blue, Bupa case-study context only. External brand: locked constant.

bupa-blue-dark.$description: Bupa brand blue, darker variant. External brand: locked constant.

bupa-blue-subtle.$description: Bupa brand blue, subtle tint. External brand: locked constant.

glitch-magenta.$description: Decorative glitch effect only (footer wordmark). Not a palette colour, never themed.

glitch-cyan.$description: Decorative glitch effect only. Not a palette colour, never themed.

surface.$description: The default card / panel surface. White card on the grey page in light (a genuine lift); the lighter near-black (#1c1c1f) in dark.

surface-sunken.$description: Recessed wells, insets, thumbnails, chips. A step below the card surface: light grey in light; the darker near-black (#141416) in dark.

surface-inverse.$description: Always-dark slab surface, theme-invariant near-black (#0a0a0b). The full-bleed testimonials section stays near-black in BOTH themes (the metrics band matches it via a local theme scope); never overridden per theme, like static-white in reverse.

surface-inverse-sunken.$description: Inset on an inverse slab, theme-invariant near-black (#141416), the same dark value as surface-sunken. The testimonial portrait image-load fallback; never overridden per theme. Reads lighter than surface-inverse because neutral.950 is the darkest stop in the scale.

border-brand.$description: The brand-lime outline accent (active selection, link underline, brand ring). Theme-invariant lime, never overridden per theme; the semantic the brand outlines read instead of the raw primitive.

static-white.$description: Theme-invariant white, never overridden per theme.

brand-emphasis.$description: Theme-aware brand-tinted text, ink on light, lime on dark.

dot-inactive.$description: Inactive carousel dot. Solid theme-aware grey: clears the SC 1.4.11 3:1 floor on light surfaces (the old rgba(127,127,127,0.45) composited to 1.67:1); dark themes override to neutral-500. Inverse bands re-scope to on-ink-muted.

dot-active.$description: Active carousel dot and position indicator. Follows the accent: ink on light, lime on dark (lime on the light page was 1.06:1, audit AX-01). Inverse bands re-scope to brand lime.

text-muted-em.$description: C-01 muted italic emphasis. 55% ink on light, flips to brand-lime on dark. Decorative and large-text use only: composites to ~3.7:1 on light surfaces, below the 4.5:1 small-text floor (audit TK-07).

on-ink-hover.$description: C-12 hover/focus tint on dark backgrounds.

display.$description: Display headings (h1, h2, h3) and large numbers.

mono.$value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: Tabular numbers, code, and eyebrow labels.

mono-metric.$value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono-metric.$description: M-21 tabular mono for metric digits.

feature-mono.$description: OpenType slashed-zero feature for mono specimens.

h1.$description: Page-level section headings (every section h2). The hero h1 is a documented exception with its own mobile-tuned clamp.

h2.$description: Card titles, ledes, sub-headings inside section bodies.

body.$description: Paragraphs, lists, default reading text, card body copy.

label.$description: Uppercase mono labels, eyebrows, stat labels, badges.

nav.$description: Header menu links; equals --text-label today, kept separate so nav can diverge.

weight.$description: Bi-weight bold. Display headings always roman.

measure.$description: Line-length cap; 52ch Inter renders ~66 real chars.

sm.$description: Compact: dense cards, toolbars, filters. Clears the WCAG 2.5.8 AA 24px target minimum.

md.$description: Default. Most CTAs. Equals the base .btn height and meets the WCAG 2.5.5 AAA 44px touch target.

lg.$description: Hero CTAs and primary conversion actions.

extrabold.$description: Five distinct weights; Inter is loaded at 400/500/600/700/800.

1.$description: Hairline gap. Icon-to-label, tight inline spacing.

2.$description: Tight gap. Chip padding, small stacks.

3.$description: Medium-tight break (added between 2 and 4). Heading-to-body, compact rows.

4.$description: Base unit. Default gap between related elements; the compact card-padding tier (--card-pad-compact).

5.$description: Medium break (added between 4 and 6). Group separation inside a section; the standard card-padding tier (--card-pad-standard).

6.$description: Large gap. Between subsections and card to card; the spacious card-padding tier (--card-pad-spacious).

7.$description: Block spacing between stacked content blocks.

8.$description: Major block separation and section inner padding.

9.$description: Section rhythm. The lower bound of vertical section padding (--section-padding).

10.$description: Section rhythm. The upper bound of vertical section padding (--section-padding).

11.$description: Outsized spacing for full-bleed editorial breaks.

12.$description: Largest step. Rare, marquee-scale vertical space.

compact.$description: Compact card-padding tier (16px). Dense content tiles: credential cards, health-check tiles, inner controls.

standard.$description: Standard card-padding tier (24px). The default content-card inset; matches the base .card. The standard, resolving the old 16-vs-24 doc conflict.

spacious.$description: Spacious card-padding tier (32px). Large feature, award, and full-testimonial cards (often the desktop step up from standard).

none.$description: Square. No rounding, for sharp-cornered surfaces and full-bleed media.

sm.$description: Small radius. The workhorse for inputs, chips, and small controls.

md.$description: Medium radius. Mid-size controls and insets, a touch rounder than sm.

lg.$description: Large radius. The default for cards and modals.

xl.$description: Extra-large radius. Prominent panels and feature surfaces.

full.$description: Full round. Pills, tags, and circular buttons; forces a complete radius at any height.

hairline.$description: Default 1px hairline border; reads --color-border so it follows the theme. The standard card edge and divider.

strong.$description: Heavier 1px border; reads --color-border-strong. For edges that need to read past a hairline, such as secondary-button outlines.

focus.$description: 2px focus outline; reads --color-focus-ring (ink on light, lime on dark). The keyboard-focus indicator, never removed without a replacement.

focus-ring-offset.$description: Offset between an element and its focus ring. Outsets the 2px ring so it clears the element edge.

wide.$description: Main content band. 92vw between 1200px and 1440px (unchanged laptop behaviour); past ~2180px viewport it grows at 66vw so big monitors fill about two-thirds of the screen instead of stranding a fixed 1440px column.

touch-target-dot.$description: Carousel-dot hit area (WCAG 2.5.8 AA floor). Was consumed with an inline fallback but defined nowhere (audit TK-09).

none.$description: No shadow. The default; the system favours borders over shadows.

soft.$description: Subtle resting elevation, two stacked ink-alpha layers, for cards that lift just off the page. Dark mode swaps to deeper black-alpha.

lift.$description: Stronger elevation for overlays and float-on-scroll chrome only, not resting cards.

modal.$description: Modal and lightbox elevation. The deepest shadow, for surfaces floating above a scrim.

accent-period-shadow.$description: Depth under the lime period in section titles. Keeps the lime dot legible on light surfaces; resolves to none in dark, where lime already reads.

accent-dot-shadow.$description: Depth under the active carousel pagination dot. Keeps the lime dot legible on light surfaces; resolves to none in dark.

glass.$description: Liquid-frosted header glass (.m-liquidfrostlit). Light defaults here; dark overrides under darkTheme + osDark. The #lg-dist refraction (feDisplacementMap scale 100) is JS-injected and gated to desktop + hover.

edge-top.$description: Lit gradient-border top stop, light from above.

specular.$description: Inner top highlight, the 3D lit edge.

shadow.$description: Drop shadow under the bar and pill.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur on the Chromium refraction path.

blur-webkit.$description: Backdrop blur on the plain-frost fallback (Safari and iOS, no displacement).

dim.$description: Backdrop brightness() clamp at rest (1 = no dimming, both themes). The themed scrolled value lives in glass.dim-scrolled. The Apple Liquid Glass method: clamp content behind the glass toward a consistent substrate so nav text keeps AA contrast.

dim-scrolled.$description: Backdrop brightness() clamp once scrolled. Light brightens the content behind the pill so dark text stays legible; dark overrides to darken it (see darkTheme + osDark). Previously inline in sections.css.

color-dot-inactive.$description: Inactive dot on dark: brighter grey to clear 3:1 on the near-black page.

glass-specular.$description: Dark: no inner specular (transparent no-op so the box-shadow list stays valid). Tuned by Nathan 2026-06-04.

glass-shadow.$description: Dark: tight contact shadow plus soft ambient. Tuned 2026-06-04.

glass-dim-scrolled.$description: Scrolled backdrop dim, dark: near-neutral per Nathan's 2026-06-04 tuning (was 0.4). NOTE: the old 0.4 darkened content behind the floating pill to protect near-white nav contrast over light images; verify legibility over light content.

highContrast.$description: prefers-contrast: more overrides layered on light. Authored here so the token source owns every theme path (audit TK-03); build.mjs emits the media query. Every value is an existing primitive.

highContrastDark.$description: prefers-contrast: more overrides layered on dark (explicit toggle AND OS dark; build.mjs emits both scopes from this one group).
